Standing at {{height|ft=6|in=9}},[http://basketball.realgm.com/player/Steven-Smith/Summary/1057 RealGM.com profile] he played both [[Forward (basketball)|forward]] positions. He played college basketball for the [[La Salle Explorers men's basketball|La Salle Explorers]]. ==College career== Smith is a graduate of [[Northeast High School (Philadelphia, Pennsylvania)|Northeast High School]], and later [[La Salle University]], where he won the [[Atlantic 10 Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year|Atlantic 10 Conference Player of the Year]] twice, in 2005 and 2006. ==Professional career== After starting the [[2006-07 NBA season]] with the [[Philadelphia 76ers]], Smith was waived in January 2007. In eight total [[NBA]] games, he averaged 0.6 points and 0.8 rebounds per game.[http://www.nba.com/sixers/news/smith_070104.html 76ers Request Waivers on Forward Steven Smith.] He also played for the [[Anaheim Arsenal]] of the [[NBA Development League|D-League]] during the 2007–08 season. In February 2008, he joined the [[Serie A (basketball)|Italian League]] pro club [[Nuova AMG Sebastiani Basket Rieti|Solsonica Rieti]] and finished the 2007–08 season there. He signed with the [[A1 Ethniki|Greek League]] pro club [[Kolossos Rodou BC|Kolossos Rodou]] for the 2008–09 season. After averaging 18.3 points per game in 21 games, he suffered an [[Achilles tendon rupture]] and missed the rest of the season.[https://jordaningram55.blogspot.com/2008/08/steven-smith-is-heading-to-greece.html Steven Smith Is Heading To Greece.] In August 2010, he signed with the [[Basketball Bundesliga|German]] [[Eurocup Basketball|Eurocup]] team [[EWE Baskets Oldenburg]],[https://web.archive.org/web/20100906142104/http://www.ewe-baskets.de/de/news/news/164-steven-smith-verstaerkt-die-ewe-baskets.html Steven
